content_sections.heading: HBCHRC Punjab Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the HBCHRC Punjab Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download HBCHRC Punjab Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: HBCHRC Punjab Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available – 1 for Junior Engineer (Civil) and 1 for Foreman Electrical.

content_sections.heading: HBCHRC Punjab Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Engineer (CIVIL): Diploma in Civil (03 years after SSC or 02 Years after HSC) From a state board of technical education. Or Higher relevant qualification from Institutes approved by State/ Central Examination. Candidate should have minimum 03 years post qualification experience with an established firm in supervision, quality control, billing of construction of multi storey buildings. Foreman Electrical: SSC Plus ITI(Electrical) NCVT/SCVT 02 years’ full time course from Govt. recognized Institute with 07 years’ experience after ITI Plus OR 06 years’ experience after ITI Plus Apprenticeship in electrical maintenance works in Industry/ Commercial Establishment/ Hospitals.

content_sections.heading: HBCHRC Punjab Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Junior Engineer: Maximum 30 years Foreman Electrical: Maximum 35 years

content_sections.heading: HBCHRC Punjab Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Junior Engineer (CIVIL): Rs. 35,000/- to Rs. 40,000/- Foreman Electrical: Rs. 25,000/- to Rs. 30,000/-

content_sections.heading: HBCHRC Punjab Recruitment 2026 - Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for HBCHRC Punjab Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for HBCHRC Punjab Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the HBCHRC Punjab Recruitment 2026 is scheduled to be held on 07 August 2026. Candidates should report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced by HBCHRC Punjab?
faq.answer: HBCHRC Punjab has announced a total of 2 vacancies for the posts of Junior Engineer (Civil) and Foreman Electrical.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Engineer (Civil) post?
faq.answer: For the Junior Engineer (Civil) post, candidates need a Diploma in Civil Engineering with a minimum of 3 years of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Foreman Electrical post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Foreman Electrical post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Engineer (Civil) position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Engineer (Civil) position ranges from Rs. 35,000/- to Rs. 40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the HBCHRC Punjab Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an MCQ Test, followed by an Interview, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions are on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre Punjab, SAS Nagar. Specific venue details will be in the official notification.
